_tokenSources: Where the tokens these files read are DECLARED. roots is src, but the tokens live in the submodule, so without this every var() into shared reads as undefined.
_runtimeTokens: Set by JS as an inline style on the element itself, so no stylesheet declares them: --logo-height and --caret-x from App.jsx, --locked-pct from the AxisSlider primitive. --ab-family and --ab-fvs are set on the calcom preview root by App.jsx in A/B screenshot mode.
_lines: On the house grid (wm-primitives GRID.md): the app's chrome, src/App.css and src/index.css, since #root is .wm-lines. linesSkip names the stages, data-nosnap in the page because their type is the user's font at the user's size and leading: the Big Word, the paragraph proof and its blocks, the type scale rows and pairs, the glyph grid, the UI board, the style panel's specimen previews, and the two cal.com mock-ups (calcom-*, coss-*), which copy cal.com's own spacing.
